name: cc-mermaid
description: Renders Mermaid diagrams from chat responses inline in the transcript (Desktop, VS Code, mobile, kitty/Ghostty terminals), with a self-contained HTML file and link as the fallback everywhere else.

inline.title: Draw diagrams inline
inline.description: Draw mermaid diagrams in the transcript where the client can (Desktop, VS Code, mobile, kitty/Ghostty). Rendered locally with mermaid-cli; off leaves the HTML link only.

mmdcPath.title: mermaid-cli path
mmdcPath.description: The mmdc executable used to render diagrams locally. Leave empty to use mmdc from PATH (npm i -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli).

terminalImages.title: Inline images in the terminal
terminalImages.description: auto draws diagrams as images only in kitty and Ghostty (the terminals with the kitty graphics protocol); always forces it on, never keeps the raw code block.
